title: Preparing Biological Samples for Metabarcoding
author: Tim Regan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bms8k6hw
materials: Starting with biological sample (filter, swab, water, biofilm, tissue etc.) stored in Qiagen Buffer ATL (or similar), transfer up to 1 mL to Matrix A bead tube. Buffer ATL Qiagen Catalog #19076 Lysing Matrix A 2 mL tube MP Biomedicals Catalog #SKU 116910050-CF

Premix 70% ethanol and Qiagen lysis buffer AL 1:1 to add to sample at a ratio of 1:1:1 e.g. for 10 samples of 500 µL each, premix 550 µL of buffer AL and 550 µL of 70% ethanol and add 1 mL of ethanol/buffer AL mixture to each sample. Buffer AL, Lysis buffer Qiagen Catalog #19076

Hereafter, the manufacturer's protocol for the Qiagen DNeasy Blood and Tissue kit is followed with some modifications: Load < 600 µL of lysate mixture (ATL, AL and EtOH) at a time into the column Spin at 6000 x g, °C, 1 minute and discard flow-through. Repeat as necessary until all lysate is loaded on column e.g. mixture of 1500 µL may take x3 initial spins and flow through discarding to complete column binding. QIAgen DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit, 50 rxn Qiagen Catalog #69504

steps.title: Perform Bead Beating
steps.instruction: Perform bead beating in a disruptor at 5.0 M/s for 40 seconds, repeated twice, ensuring the tube looks somewhat homogenous.

steps.title: Incubate with Metapolyzyme
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of Metapolyzyme (Merck MilliporeSigma/Sigma-Aldrich Catalog #MAC4L-5MG) to each tube and vortex briefly, then incubate at 37 °C for 2 hours.

steps.title: Incubate with Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of Proteinase K (100mg Promega Catalog #V3021) to each tube, vortex for 10 seconds, and incubate at 56 °C overnight.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Clarify Samples
steps.instruction: Vortex samples for 15 seconds and centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Isolate Supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant (up to 900 µL) from each tube into a new tube and centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 minute. Then, transfer up to 600 µL of the bead-free supernatant to a new 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Place the DNeasy Mini spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW1, and centrifuge at 6,000 x g (8,000 rpm) for 1 minute. Discard the flow-through and collection tube.

steps.title: Wash and Dry with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Place the DNeasy Mini spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW2, and centrifuge at 20,000 x g for 3 minutes to dry the DNeasy membrane. Discard the flow-through and collection tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Perform final elution in 100 µL of AE buffer.

steps.title: Quantify Extracted DNA
steps.instruction: Check the approximate concentration of extracted DNA using a Nanodrop.

steps.title: Dilute DNA for PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1:10 dilution of each extraction to avoid PCR inhibition, then perform further dilution to a maximum final concentration of ~1 ng/μl - 10 ng/μl.

steps.title: Prepare PCR Reaction
steps.instruction: Use ~50 ng of DNA in a 20 µL per sequencing library PCR reaction (refer to amplicon library PCR protocol).
